XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine fault warning light comes on
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P1172 | LIGHTS UP | ON | YELLOW | YELLOW | REMAINS | MIL |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: - -

  • Fault: Engine fault light comes on with both LPG and petrol fuel systems active.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P1172 (Mixture 1 multiplier - Error)

  • Cause: Incorrect petrol injection parameter configuration

• Action: Using diagnostic equipment, perform the following "Reset adaptive parameters" procedure in the petrol injection system

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: If the engine fault light starts flashing, it may be necessary to accelerate repeatedly with the engine warm to turn off the fault light.
